reason: This would sit directly in our order path, and the vendor has no SOC 2 report, no customers and no references, so it would not get through our vendor-risk review. Even a free design-partner pilot needs that review, and I'm not signing a letter of intent that names a price for a vendor I can't onboard.
objection: A proxy in front of every agent trade is a single point of failure and a new attack surface. If it goes down or gets compromised, our customers' orders stop or go through wrong, and I'd be the one explaining to examiners why we let an unaudited startup into the trade path.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report plus two or three reference customers at regulated brokers who already run it in production, ideally with a fail-open/fail-closed design our CISO has signed off on.
